text: 国家发展改革委政策研究室副主任李超在发改委8月份例行发布会上表示，下一步国家发展改革委将聚焦务实管用、落地见效，以具身智能实训场和应用中试基地为抓手，让机器人在真实场景中迭代技术，围绕真实需求形成应用闭环。
text_en: Li Chao, Deputy Director of the NDRC Policy Research Office, said at the August regular press conference that going forward, the NDRC will focus on practical, effective implementation, using embodied-intelligence training grounds and application pilot bases as levers, so that robots can iterate technology in real scenarios and form an application loop around real needs.
